comments.text: Der8auer did some similar videos a few years ago, but in English: [LINK] [VIDEO] The second is especially interesting as it demonstrates Hetzner's unique semi-custom hardware.

comments.author: jsheard
comments.why: Custom stripped-down motherboards arranged for rack airflow
comments.text: There's some videos out there showing off their custom motherboards, it's an odd mixture of standard-ish consumer ATX but stripped down to the absolute bare essentials and with some components rearranged for better airflow in racks chassis they also build themselves: [VIDEO] Another video showing the custom racks and other infrastructure: [LINK]

comments.author: dist-epoch
comments.why: ASUS AM5 boards with rotated CPU and memory block for airflow
comments.text: Hetzner is buying ASUS consumer AM5 motherboards, but with the whole CPU + memory block rotated so that the memory sticks are horizontal instead of vertical for better airflow: [VIDEO]
